title: Omni Chest
description: An Omni Chest is like an Ender Chest, but public for everyone
body:
This is a tiny mod that adds Omni Chest.

It is like a world-wide Ender Chest that is shared with everyone, everywhere. Every Omni Chest is connected to each other.

You can use it for item transport if you have a friend on the other side, but you can't stop someone else from getting them either. How you use it is up to you. 

You craft an Omni Chest from an Ender Chest:

Note

In older versions, this mod used to be a part of XercaMod before it was split.
